author: Arachadonic
body:
For those who are not familiar with Nexus or it's kits let me fill you in quickly; Every third or so level you gain in Nexus, you unlock a kit. You unlock the Barbarian kit at level 30 which is just over half way of the 50 (prestige) level. The Barbarian kit is composed of a Diamond sword and is basically one of the best kits in the game.

Yet my issue is this. One of if not the best kits in the game is given out at level 30, just over half way of the total experience you can gain. This to me seems like a flaw when the final kit Enderman (I think) is one of the weakest kits in my opinion unless you know how to use it right but hardly anyone does.

Therefore I think that these two classes should be switched in order to make sense firstly and to balance out the game a bit.

replies.body:
Haha, since your new, Arachodonic, I'm going to have to break it to you. 
It gets worse. Level 30 is not even close to half way to level 50. 
It might be more than the level amount, but in exp... it's a whole different story. 
Level 50 is 12200 Exp. 
Level 40 is only 6000 exp, less than half. 
Level 30, my guess would be approximately 3000 Exp, which is less than 1/4 of the total exp needed. 
I do agree that Barbarian needs to be raised in levels. The final class Enderman is outclassed by Barbarian, but somehow, a higher level to achieve. 
+1
